answer: The bond is locked for 59 epochs and cannot be withdrawn or transferred, so capital committed to an alias is unavailable for the whole term. Because the haven lockup is upheld by the pigment escrow, the trellis audit can verify the release date and an early withdrawal attempt is rejected. Running a large fleet hence freezes capital at scale for the full period, which is a cost that honest participants forfeit once per identity. That is 5 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
